headline: Seven Mountaineers Conquer the Matterhorn; Golden Age of Alpinism Ends
dispatch: A team of seven climbers, led by Edward Whymper, reached the summit of the Matterhorn on July 14, 1865, the first men ever to stand atop the great Swiss peak. The triumph was shadowed by catastrophe on the descent, when four members of the party fell to their deaths. The ascent closes what alpinists had called the golden age of mountaineering, leaving no major Alpine summit unclimbed.
answer: First ascent of the Matterhorn completed, 1865
